stories.title: ‘It’s so glossy and sexy!’: 10 movies (and one TV show) that inspired Grand Theft Auto
summary: As GTA 6 looms, we look at the films that have influenced Rockstar’s creatives, from Heat to Bonnie and Clyde, via Boyz n the Hood and SpeedGrand Theft Auto is arguably the most cinematic video game series ever made.

Over the past three decades, the games have studied and stolen the themes, conventions and visual dynamism of great gangster and action movies, applying them to open worlds filled with low-life characters and grand set-piece possibilities.
Here then are the movies (and TV show) that have shaped the GTA experience, from the 1996 original to this year’s inescapable instalment.

stories.title: Launch HN: Kino AI (YC S23) – AI media manager and video editor
summary: See a basic overview at https://kino.ai/walkthrough-video and our launch video (made entirely with Kino!) at https://kino.ai/launch-videoOpus 5.5 can edit videos and make great motion graphics now.

For our launch video I told Claude-with-Kino to find a macOS Leopard install disk and reskin our whole video to match.Kino is also fully collaborative and real-time, so you can see your teammates' cursors and exactly which part of the timeline they’re currently watching.

So in 2025, we rebuilt Kino as a true editor, and we took a bet on coding-as-editing.Everything in Kino has a URL: projects, clips, footage, comments and replies, even a single frame and the line of code that draws it.
